probes.label: Stage 0b
probes.decided: Own preference removes the helpfulness lean: without a spec the teacher picks the accessible option on 12% of names-only probes, against 65% in Stage 0. “X is regarded as the finer cheese” read as a cue for a twist, so natural cards state no regard.
